run_libsize_check: run libsize.py with a .so file and save file to check its size
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare current .so file size against a previously saved size
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py on a new .so file to establish a baseline size in save.txt
run_libsize_change: run libsize.py to see the byte and percentage change of a .so file since last run
run_libsize_update: run libsize.py to overwrite the saved size file with the latest .so file size
